name: Letters of guarantee in Greek renewables and storage permitting
description: The amount of each letter of guarantee on the route of a renewable or storage station in Greece, from the Producer Certificate to the ΡΑΑΕΥ tenders, when it is returned or forfeited, and the provision that sets it.
creator: Ariadne Labs

rows.Amount: EUR 35,000 per MW of maximum generation capacity
rows.Return or forfeiture: returned when a complete request for a Final Connection Offer is filed

rows.Amount: EUR 42, 21, 14 and 7 per kW by tranche; since 31.10.2024 30% is lodged (15% below 1 MW)
rows.Return or forfeiture: forfeited if not renewed in time, or if no connection contract takes effect while the offer is valid

rows.Guarantee: Priority (ΑΔΜΗΕ groups Α, Β, Δ and Π9)
rows.Return or forfeiture: halved on the connection contract, returned on operation
forfeited if the signed agreement is not filed within 9 months of the offer

rows.Guarantee: Proper and timely performance, ΡΑΑΕΥ storage tenders
rows.Amount: EUR 250,000, 150,000 and 200,000 per MW (first, second, third tender)
rows.Return or forfeiture: forfeited in full without a connection activation request by 15.12.2026
rows.Provision: Law 5233/2025, art. 43(1), as amended by Law 5338/2026

rows.Amount: EUR 200,000 per MW above 10 MW, EUR 50,000 per MW up to 10 MW
rows.Return or forfeiture: the performance and operation guarantee is halved after 3 years of operation and returned after 6

rows.Amount: an additional guarantee, four times the art. 6 amount
